answer_1.quote: We propose a novel training-free and reference-free metric for both multiple and single document summarization evaluation.
answer_1.outputs: evaluation scores (relevance, redundancy) for generated summaries

answer_2.quote: We compute correlation coefficients between predicted scores of an evaluation method and the annotated Pyramid scores of summaries to measure the effectiveness of the method.

answer_4.quote: For CNNDM dataset, correlations are calculated with the human scores in three dimensions including Overall, Grammar, and Redundancy.
answer_4.guideline: Compute correlation between metric scores and human ratings across dimensions.
